data.explanation: This is your income tax assessment (Einkommensteuerbescheid) for 2025. Your tax is higher than the wage tax your employer already paid, so you must pay the difference of €634.00 by 30 April 2026 to the account shown, using the given payment reference. If you think the assessment is wrong, you may file an objection (Einspruch) with the tax office in writing, via ELSTER or in person; the app shows until when. Paying does not remove your right to object. A tax adviser or income tax help association can help if you are unsure.
